data.title: Is It Too Late to Buy Bitcoin After a 32% Rally in Two Months?
data.description: Bitcoin just posted its strongest two-month surge of the year, yet buyers from 2025 are still sitting on massive losses. Whether this rally signals a genuine recovery or a trap for late investors comes down to a few critical price levels.
